name: Better Cores
description: Keeps the tunnel cores of the panel up to date and carries the WARP engine other plugins build on. Once a day (and on a button) it looks for a newer release of OpenFlux, mieru and TrustTunnel, shows it on the panel's Settings → Cores page and installs it in place of the panel's own copy when you press Update; after a panel update it puts the same release back. The WARP engine is an AmneziaWG client in the plugin that checks a Cloudflare WARP account and endpoint through a real tunnel and scans Cloudflare's endpoints for the quickest; Better WARP requires it.
author: AllIsA1
